title: Restriction of ordinary Hom complexes, natural in the coefficient complex
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq Y$ an open, and $L^\bullet$ an integer cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-hom-complex]. Write $R$ for restriction of module sheaves to the open subscheme $U$, and $R_c$ for its termwise action on complexes. There is a natural isomorphism of functors on the whole category of integer cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules:
$$R_c(\mathcal Hom_Y^\bullet(L^\bullet,-))\ \cong\ \mathcal Hom_U^\bullet(R_c(L^\bullet),R_c(-)).$$
No boundedness, finite freeness, augmentation, or derived category is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 20.42.3: ordinary Hom restriction in the construction of RHom, transported by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv

proof.text: Identify each sheaf Hom after restriction by restricting local module maps and transporting them through the over-site equivalence. The local map identification commutes with postcomposition by a map of coefficient modules.

Restriction and the over-site equivalence preserve all products. Apply the preceding identification to every product factor of each total Hom degree. The formula for the Hom differential is respected, since the identification preserves postcomposition, precomposition, and addition. This constructs componentwise chain isomorphisms.

For every coefficient chain map, check the naturality square on each product projection. Both sides are restriction of the same postcomposition of local module maps, so they agree. Assemble the chain isomorphisms into a natural isomorphism; this includes zero complexes and empty U.

theorem homComplex_restrict_scheme_natural {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      (homComplexFunctor (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op L) ⋙
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (homComplexFunctor (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj
          (op (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            L)))
